jobs.description:

**What we offer:**
------------------


At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry\-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.**Group Summary:**
------------------


Magna is more than one of the world’s largest suppliers in the automotive space. We are a mobility technology company built to innovate, with a global, entrepreneurial\-minded team. With 65\+ years of expertise, our ecosystem of interconnected products combined with our complete vehicle expertise uniquely positions us to advance mobility in an expanded transportation landscape.**Job Responsibilities:**

  

The Director, GBS Finance \& Controlling plays a key role in the financial management and strategic planning of Global Business Services (GBS) across North America, Europe, India and China. GBS provides Finance, Accounting and Human Resources services to the Magna organization.  



  

Reporting directly to the VP Finance – Continuous Improvement, this hands\-on leadership role is responsible for strengthening and developing the finance team while directly delivering core finance and controlling activities, including planning, analysis, reporting, controls, pricing, business case development, project controlling and cash flow management. The role partners closely with GBS business leaders to provide practical financial guidance, support informed decision\-making and ensure regulatory compliance and the long\-term financial health of GBS.

 **Your Responsibilities**

 **Financial Planning and Analys**is:

* Lead GBS Business Planning and Forecast process; full cycle (service/project pricing, strategic planning, detail operational plan and forecasting)
* Proper financial analysis, identifying risks and opportunities, and providing recommendations to improve financial performance and profitability.
* Monitor and analyze financial metrics, key performance indicators (KPIs), and financial trends.
* Ensure proper pricing of services/project hours
* Develop and evaluate business cases for various projects, providing clear financial assumptions, scenario analyses and recommendations.
* Lead project controlling activities, including budget tracking, variance analysis, financial performance monitoring and reporting.

 **Financial Reporting and Control**:

* Preparation of accurate and timely financial statements, reports, and presentations for various stakeholders; attesting the financials properly reflect the business performance
* Ensure compliance with accounting principles, guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
* Establish and maintain effective internal controls to safeguard company assets.
* Strategic Financial Leadership:
* Provide strategic insights and financial expertise to support key decision\-making processes.
* Build strong partnerships with GBS business leaders and cross\-functional teams, developing a deep understanding of operations to evaluate business proposals, investments and potential acquisitions and provide practical, informed financial guidance.

 **Cash Flow Management**:

* Manage cash flow, optimize working capital, and ensure adequate liquidity.

 **Team Leadership and Development**:

* Strengthen, lead and develop a global team of financial professionals, providing clear direction, guidance and hands\-on support.
* Foster a culture of excellence, integrity, and continuous improvement within the finance department.
* Identify talent gaps and develop succession plans to ensure the long\-term success of the team.

 **Who we are looking fo**r

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field.
* Proven experience in a senior financial management role, preferably within manufacturing, automotive or a shared services environment.
* Strong knowledge of financial planning and analysis, financial reporting and internal controls.
* Extensive knowledge of accounting principles, consolidation, cost accounting, transfer pricing, taxation, regulatory compliance and financial management in an international business environment.
* Strong understanding of applicable accounting and reporting frameworks, statutory requirements, direct and indirect tax compliance, and financial statement and regulatory report preparation across jurisdictions.
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving capability, with the ability to translate financial information into actionable business insights.
* Strong systems proficiency, including Excel, PowerPoint, data warehouse tools, OneStream and SAP.
* Proven leadership and people management capability, including experience developing high\-performing finance teams.
* Ability to communicate and present effectively to senior executives and board members.

 **Your preferred qualifications**


* MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field.
* Experience supporting a global shared services organization across multiple regions and jurisdictions.
* Advanced proficiency with OneStream, SAP, Excel, PowerPoint and data warehouse environments.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Commercial Data Operations
jobs.description:
Location: Mississauga, Canada Job reference: R\-262602 Date posted: 10/23/2026
When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That’s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn’t mean we’re not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.


The Associate Director, Commercial Data Operations leads the delivery and reliability of data that supports US Commercial decisions, operations, reporting and advanced analytics at Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease. You will set priorities and operating standards across commercial data assets, partner with technology teams to deliver governed data products, and lead the response to material data issues. The role spans specialty pharmacy and distribution, patient services, claims, customer and product master data, customer engagement and performance data.


**Accountabilities:**


* Portfolio Leadership: Set and sequence priorities across new data sources, product launches, enhancements, and production support; translate business needs into a clear roadmap, delivery plans, and decisions on scope, timing, and dependencies.
* Data Product Ownership: Define business outcomes, common definitions, ownership, and acceptance criteria for reusable commercial data products; partner with engineering on models, lineage, access, testing, and transition from build to sustained operations.
* Source Onboarding and Integration: Assess internal and vendor data, contracts, and file specifications; coordinate design, historical loads, validation, and downstream readiness for reporting, Decision Science, CRM, and other consumers.
* Launch Readiness: Map the end\-to\-end flow—from source and master data through ingestion, data products, CRM alignment, reporting, and alerts; confirm dependencies, testing, and cutover plans; ensure downstream consumers are ready before launch.
* Production Reliability: Establish service expectations, monitoring, incident response, and escalation for critical feeds and pipelines; analyze recurring failures, drive corrective action with IT and vendors, and communicate business impact and recovery plans.
* Architecture, MDM, and Change Stewardship: Review designs and source\-to\-target mappings for scalability, maintainability, and downstream impact; partner on HCP, HCO, and product identity, affiliations, hierarchies, and cross\-system keys; align with enterprise standards while protecting US Commercial requirements.
* Leadership of Partners and Teams: Direct internal team members and external partners; clarify accountabilities, coach strong technical and business judgment, and hold vendors accountable for quality, schedules, and issue resolution.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with Trade and Distribution, Patient Services, Market Access, Commercial Operations, Reporting and Insights, Decision Science, and IT; resolve competing priorities and provide concise updates on risks, decisions, and delivery status.
* Data Quality and Controls: Define critical data elements, thresholds, and controls across freshness, completeness, accuracy, consistency, and reconciliation; sponsor automated checks, dashboards, exception ownership, and alerting; require evidence for validation and regression testing; maintain lineage, documentation, and issue history so consumers understand data limits and changes.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**


* Education and experience: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience, with 8 or more years in pharmaceutical or healthcare commercial data management, operations or engineering, including leadership of complex initiatives.
* Commercial data and MDM expertise: Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial data across specialty pharmacy or patient services, claims, CRM and performance. Understanding of HCP, HCO and product mastering, matching, affiliations and hierarchies, and their effect on downstream data products.
* Technical judgment: Advanced SQL and practical Snowflake experience for profiling, reconciliation and root cause analysis. Ability to review data models, pipeline designs, transformations and architecture with engineering teams; working knowledge of Python and orchestration or transformation tools.
* Data product and quality leadership: Experience defining reusable datasets, business rules, ownership, lineage, quality controls and release acceptance criteria across multiple data sources and consumers.
* Delivery leadership: Proven ability to run a portfolio of concurrent requests, incidents and launches; prioritize by business impact; lead testing, cutovers and operational handover; and manage vendors and delivery partners.
* Communication and influence: Ability to challenge ambiguous requirements, make tradeoffs clear, develop colleagues and influence senior business and technology stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**


* Rare disease and vendor knowledge: Experience with specialty pharmacy and distribution feeds, including patient status, dispense, inventory and shipment data; familiarity with Veeva, IQVIA, Komodo or similar sources.
* Modern data platform delivery: Experience with Snowflake, Airflow, dbt, S3, secure sharing, Git based releases and data product frameworks across raw, staging and curated layers.
* AI and Decision Science enablement: Experience applying AI or advanced analytics to data operations or quality monitoring, such as anomaly detection and investigation. Understanding of model inputs, scores and outputs used for field alerts, including validation, refresh timing and production support with Decision Science teams.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
**Join the Digital Health Revolution!**

 **About Pillway:**


Pillway is Canada’s premier digital pharmacy, redefining patient care through technology, innovation, and relentless operational excellence. We simplify medication management with intelligent adherence tools, personalized care, and seamless nationwide delivery empowering patients and caregivers with a modern, connected healthcare experience.


We aren't just a pharmacy, we are a fast\-scaling healthcare technology company driving the future of the industry. By **revolutionizing patient care** through proprietary digital solutions, we deliver an unmatched, patient\-first model. Join our high\-impact team to directly shape the **future of Canadian pharmacy services**!

**Role Overview:**


Pillway is seeking an experienced data\-driven and strategic Growth Hacker. This role is critical for analyzing post\-sign\-up behavior, identifying funnel leakages, and implementing re\-engagement strategies to increase conversions and customer loyalty on our platform.


Pillway is seeking an experienced Director of Finance that will lead Pillway’s finance, accounting, FP\&A, and data analytics functions, serving as a key financial and analytical partner to executive leadership. In this role, you will oversee the finance and accounting team to ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of all organizational financial information while building scalable processes, reporting capabilities, and robust internal controls.

**Core Responsibilities:**

**Champion Financial \& Accounting Operations**

* Drive core accounting functions including AP, AR, general ledger, and close cycles ensuring pristine financial accuracy and integrity.
* Maintain impeccable financial records across multiple corporate entities and lead consolidated reporting with rigor.
* Optimize liquidity, capital allocation, and internal controls to protect and scale the company's financial health.
* Spearhead process automation and operational enhancements to build a modern, high\-efficiency finance department.

**Elevate Financial Reporting \& Audit Governance**

* Deliver seamless monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages for executive leadership, board members, and investors.
* Serve as the primary liaison for external auditors and tax advisors, fostering complete audit\-readiness and compliance.

**Shape Strategic FP\&A \& Growth Planning**

* Lead annual budgeting, continuous rolling forecasts, and dynamic financial models that guide strategic direction.
* Analyze performance trends, cost structures, and variances to unlock actionable insights and maximize profitability.
* Evaluate new investments, key commercial agreements, and expansion opportunities to accelerate business growth.

**Lead Data \& Analytics Innovation**

* Direct the Data \& Analytics team to build robust, company\-wide business intelligence tools and interactive KPI dashboards.
* Empower cross\-functional leaders with data transparency and metrics that inform key operational choices.

**Inspire Leadership \& Continuous Improvement**

* Mentor, develop, and empower a top\-tier team across finance, accounting, and analytics.
* Foster cross\-functional collaboration across operations, sales, marketing, and customer service to drive organizational excellence.

**Required Qualifications**

* CPA designation strongly preferred.
* 7–10\+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including people leadership.
* Strong technical accounting foundation, including financial statements, reconciliations, and audit preparation.
* Demonstrated experience managing accounting teams and overseeing financial operations.
* Strong FP\&A capabilities, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling.
* Strong working knowledge of Canadian accounting standards (ASPE or IFRS), including financial statement preparation, consolidated reporting, and external audit requirements
* Advanced Excel skills and experience with financial/accounting systems.
* Ability to interpret business data and communicate financial insights to senior leadership.
* Experience in multi\-entity or multi\-location organizations preferred.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools is considered an asset.
* Healthcare, pharmacy, technology, or transaction\-intensive business experience considered an asset.

### **Why Join the Pillway Team?**


At Pillway, we are transforming pharmacy care across Canada through technology, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to patient\-centric healthcare. As our Director of Finance, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our strategic trajectory, driving operational excellence, and scaling a high\-impact financial organization.

* **Strategic Financial Leadership**: Directly influence executive decision\-making, capital allocation, and long\-term expansion in a high\-growth health\-tech environment.
* **Competitive Compensation \& Equity**: Receive a highly market\-competitive salary, comprehensive health coverage, and opportunities for long\-term equity participation through our Employee Stock Option Plan.
* **Flexible Work Environment**: Enjoy a workplace culture that values flexibility, collaboration, and maintaining strong engagement across corporate teams.
* **Innovation \& Ownership**: Build and scale modern finance, FP\&A, and analytics operations, supported by an inclusive, mission\-driven team committed to excellence.


Join us at Pillway for a chance to shape the future of digital healthcare, where your work impacts lives daily, and innovation meets inclusivity.

### **Our Commitment to You**


Pillway supports a workforce of diverse backgrounds and encompasses policies and initiatives designed to help all employees feel welcomed and well\-equipped to succeed. We are an inclusive employer and provide accommodations for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. Please let us know if you require accommodation.

jobs.title: Director, Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
The Canada Segment manages a significant portfolio of strategic investments and transformation initiatives. This role will help strengthen enterprise governance, portfolio oversight, and execution discipline to ensure investments are aligned to business priorities and deliver measurable outcomes.

  

  

The Director, Strategy \& Transformation, will help build and evolve these capabilities, strengthening how investments are prioritized, governed, and delivered and providing greater transparency and decision support across the portfolio.

  

  

The selected candidate will be a rigorous, hands\-on builder and self\-starter with strong program governance and delivery discipline, analytical capabilities, and sound business judgment. They will bring fresh perspectives, challenge assumptions, and turn ideas into action, while navigating complex, cross\-functional transformations and partnering with senior leaders to drive accountability and outcomes.

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

  

Transformation Portfolio Governance (75%)

  

  

* Lead and evolve portfolio governance and management practices, including prioritization, investment planning, delivery oversight, dependencies, and executive decision support.
* Help build the Canada Segment’s next\-generation transformation and portfolio management capability, including the evolution of broader PMO capabilities.
* Lead annual and multi\-year portfolio planning, partnering with Finance, business leaders and functional partners to assess investments, challenge business cases, and align resources to strategic priorities.
* Provide senior leaders with clear portfolio insights, recommendations, and trade\-offs, supported by consistent standards for reporting, benefits realization, and delivery performance.
* Build strong cross\-functional partnerships to surface risks and dependencies early, strengthen accountability, and continuously improve how the portfolio is governed and delivered.

  

Enterprise Visibility and Strategic Initiatives (25%)

  

  

* Support high\-profile strategy and enterprise exercises, translating complex business issues into clear perspectives, recommendations, and executive narratives.
* Develop compelling materials for Canada Segment and Enterprise Leadership Teams, the Board of Directors, Rating Agencies, and other senior stakeholders.
* Partner across the organization to synthesize strategic, financial, and business perspectives and ensure senior leaders are well equipped for key discussions and decisions.

  

**Required** **Qualifications:**

  

  

* 10\+ years of experience in transformation, program/portfolio management, strategy, governance, or complex project delivery, with experience supporting senior\-level decisions and priorities.
* Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with demonstrated experience developing clear, compelling materials and recommendations for senior executives, ELT, and Board\-level audiences.
* Strong business and analytical judgment, with the ability to assess business cases, challenge assumptions, identify risks and dependencies, and support informed trade\-offs.
* Proven ability to translate complex strategy and delivery information into clear, executive\-ready insights and recommendations.
* Exceptional relationship\-building and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and mobilize cross\-functional teams in a complex organization.
* Bilingualism (English and French) is a strong asset. If the successful candidate is in Québec, proficiency in both languages will be required to support clients from various provinces outside of Quebec
  

  

**When you join our team:**

  

  

* We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
* We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well\-being and inclusion are more than just words.
* As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

  

  

  

  

The role being advertised is an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Part-Time Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
jobs.description:
**The Arrangement:**

* **Time commitment:** 1 day (8 hours) per week. Potential to expand an additional day per week.
* **Location:** Our Niagara Region office
* **Schedule:** Flexible, with days and hours to be agreed upon
* **Compensation:** $84/hour based on experience
* **Additional compensation and benefits:** potential eligibility for benefits, employer\-matched RRSP contributions, and other arrangements, subject to discussion

**Company Overview:**

We are an established, Niagara\-based general contracting and construction management company serving a diverse range of clients and projects throughout Southern Ontario. Our business is built on strong relationships, sound construction management, financial discipline and a commitment to delivering quality projects. We have a young, driven leadership team and are focused on building a strong foundation for the company’s continued growth and long\-term success.

We operate an integrated Sage and Procore project accounting and management system. We are looking for a finance leader who understands how to leverage these systems to strengthen job\-cost reporting, work\-in\-progress (WIP) analysis, forecasting and management decision\-making.

**The Opportunity:**

We are seeking an experienced Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) to join our team in a part\-time CFO capacity, working approximately one to two days per week from our Niagara office. You will work directly alongside our leadership team, sharing your experience, strengthening financial oversight, and helping develop the financial reporting and management practices that support the company’s continued success.

*This position may be particularly appealing to someone who is recently retired, approaching retirement, working independently as a consultant, or currently holding a part\-time position and looking for an additional opportunity to contribute their expertise.*

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Financial Reporting and Oversight**

* Oversee the preparation and review of monthly financial statements and management reports
* Coordinate annual financial statements and work with external accountants and auditors as required
* Review accounting procedures, internal controls, and financial reporting processes
* Provide financial insight and guidance to leadership team

**2\. Construction Accounting and Job Costing**

* Review of work\-in\-progress (WIP) schedules and percentages\-of\-completion reporting
* Oversee job\-cost reporting, project profitability analysis, and cost\-to\-complete forecasting.
* Review project budgets, committed costs, estimated costs to complete, and projected margins.
* Help identify financial risks and emerging project issues before they become problems.
* Support accurate reporting of project profitability across both construction management and stipulated\-price contracting work.

**3\. Sage and Procore Systems Integration**

* Understand and leverage our integrated Sage and Procore project accounting and management system
* Ensure project\-level financial information is accurately reflected in accounting reports and management financial statements.
* Work with accounting and project management staff to improve the flow, accuracy, and consistency of financial data between systems.
* Develop reliable reporting processes that connect project budgets, commitments, actual costs, forecasts, WIP, and cash flow.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting, controls, and system utilization to support better financial and operational decisions.

**4\. Cash Flow and Working Capital Management**

* Prepare and review cash flow forecasts and cash flow reporting.
* Monitor working capital, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and collections.
* Provide oversight of construction holdbacks, statutory payment obligations, and lien\-related financial processes.
* Help improve cash flow visibility and financial planning across the business.

**5\. Construction Legislation and Compliance**

* Maintain a working knowledge of Ontario’s Construction Act, including lien rights, statutory holdbacks, and prompt\-payment requirements.
* Understand the legislative reforms introduced through Bill 142 and their implications for Ontario construction businesses.
* Advise management on relevant financial compliance requirements and construction\-industry best practices.

**6\. Management Reporting and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Develop and monitor meaningful financial and operational KPIs.
* Provide clear reporting on gross profit, overhead, profitability, cash flow, WIP, and project performance.
* Help management understand the numbers behind business performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and strategic decision\-making.
* Provide concise, practical financial reporting that enables the leadership team to identify issues and make timely, informed decisions.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* CPA designation (formerly CA, CMA, or CGA).
* Significant experience in a senior accounting, controller, finance director, or CFO role.
* Direct experience with general contracting, construction management, or the construction industry.
* Strong understanding of construction accounting, WIP, job costing, holdbacks, and cash flow management
* Familiarity with Ontario’s Construction Act and the legislative reforms associated with Bill 142\.
* Experience with Sage accounting systems and construction project\-management platforms.
* Experience with integrated accounting and project management systems, ideally Sage and Procore, and the ability to turn project data into reliable financial reporting.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate financial information clearly to non\-financial managers.
* A practical, hands\-on approach and the ability to work effectively with a young, driven leadership tea

Pay: $84\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 8\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Grimsby Power Director Of Finance
Director, Strategic Deal Finance
jobs.description:
Liftoff is a leading AI\-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end\-to\-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high\-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.



Liftoff's solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.


We're seeking a Director to lead Deal Desk within Liftoff's Strategic Finance team that reports to the VP of Strategic Finance. This is a high\-ownership role at the center of how Liftoff structures, approves, and manages commercial agreements, from standard arrangements to complex, non\-standard deals with strategic advertising partners. As the ultimate DRI for revenue adjustments, deal economics, and the integrity of Liftoff's commercial commitments, you will partner closely with GTM, Finance, and senior leadership to set deal strategy, manage active deal performance, and ensure every commercial arrangement is entered into with a clear, defensible financial rationale. If you have deep comfort with ambiguity, strong independent judgment, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to lead cross\-functional processes with confidence, we want to hear from you!


**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------


* Serve as DRI for all revenue adjustments in weekly reporting: own the underlying logic, file integrity, and formula soundness.
* Maintain active reconciliation checks and ensure adjustments are accurate, complete, and explainable at any point in the week.
* Work proactively with cross\-functional partners throughout the week to incorporate new intel before weekly close.
* Lead weekly alignment meetings with the FP\&A team; own WoW variance explanation and post summaries to relevant stakeholders.
* Own all deal types end\-to\-end ranging from standard structures to complex, unique, and customer\-specific arrangements.
* Maintain and enforce the Deal Desk approval matrix; lead a bi\-annual Deal Desk Strategy Review with SLT.
* Own the philosophy and commercial logic underlying how Liftoff approaches deal structures, including eligibility thresholds and deal parameters by customer segment.
* For non\-standard deals: lead upfront diligence including detailed financial modeling.
* Lead weekly cross\-functional reviews on active non\-standard deals; make budget and commercial adjustment recommendations as needed.
* Produce monthly performance updates on active deal programs for senior leadership, with clear variance analysis against original assumptions.
* Monitor cash flows and financial commitments on structured deals; update models as actuals come in and flag deviations proactively.
* Own and lead accrual review for all key Deal Desk items, including complex arrangements.
* Hold a well\-supported, defensible position on accrual levels, with the underlying data and logic ready to present in senior Finance forums.
* This role includes direct management of a Senior Analyst, with responsibility for mentorship, prioritization, and maintaining high analytical standards across Deal Desk operations

**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in commercial finance, deal desk, revenue operations, or strategic finance; at least 5 years with direct ownership over deal structuring or commercial agreements.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex deal economics independently, build defensible financial models, and present clear recommendations to senior leadership.
* Strong understanding of revenue recognition, accrual accounting, and the operational mechanics of commercial deal management.
* Exceptional judgment: able to hold a position under commercial pressure while remaining collaborative and solutions\-oriented.
* Track record of true DRI ownership, including proactively surfacing risks, driving process, and escalating only when genuinely warranted.
* Excellent communicator with experience presenting to CXO\-level audiences.


**Nice to have:**


* Ad tech, programmatic advertising, or mobile experience


If you're passionate about driving commercial excellence, managing complex deal structures, and partnering with leadership to ensure sound financial decision\-making, we want to hear from you! Working at Liftoff is fast\-paced, fun, and challenging, and we thrive on innovation. Come join the rocket ship and help shape the future of the mobile app ecosystem with us!

new_jobs.title: Director, Strategy & Transformation
new_jobs.description:
The Canada Segment manages a significant portfolio of strategic investments and transformation initiatives. This role will help strengthen enterprise governance, portfolio oversight, and execution discipline to ensure investments are aligned to business priorities and deliver measurable outcomes.

  

  

The Director, Strategy \& Transformation, will help build and evolve these capabilities, strengthening how investments are prioritized, governed, and delivered and providing greater transparency and decision support across the portfolio.

  

  

The selected candidate will be a rigorous, hands\-on builder and self\-starter with strong program governance and delivery discipline, analytical capabilities, and sound business judgment. They will bring fresh perspectives, challenge assumptions, and turn ideas into action, while navigating complex, cross\-functional transformations and partnering with senior leaders to drive accountability and outcomes.

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

  

Transformation Portfolio Governance (75%)

  

  

* Lead and evolve portfolio governance and management practices, including prioritization, investment planning, delivery oversight, dependencies, and executive decision support.
* Help build the Canada Segment’s next\-generation transformation and portfolio management capability, including the evolution of broader PMO capabilities.
* Lead annual and multi\-year portfolio planning, partnering with Finance, business leaders and functional partners to assess investments, challenge business cases, and align resources to strategic priorities.
* Provide senior leaders with clear portfolio insights, recommendations, and trade\-offs, supported by consistent standards for reporting, benefits realization, and delivery performance.
* Build strong cross\-functional partnerships to surface risks and dependencies early, strengthen accountability, and continuously improve how the portfolio is governed and delivered.

  

Enterprise Visibility and Strategic Initiatives (25%)

  

  

* Support high\-profile strategy and enterprise exercises, translating complex business issues into clear perspectives, recommendations, and executive narratives.
* Develop compelling materials for Canada Segment and Enterprise Leadership Teams, the Board of Directors, Rating Agencies, and other senior stakeholders.
* Partner across the organization to synthesize strategic, financial, and business perspectives and ensure senior leaders are well equipped for key discussions and decisions.

  

**Required** **Qualifications:**

  

  

* 10\+ years of experience in transformation, program/portfolio management, strategy, governance, or complex project delivery, with experience supporting senior\-level decisions and priorities.
* Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with demonstrated experience developing clear, compelling materials and recommendations for senior executives, ELT, and Board\-level audiences.
* Strong business and analytical judgment, with the ability to assess business cases, challenge assumptions, identify risks and dependencies, and support informed trade\-offs.
* Proven ability to translate complex strategy and delivery information into clear, executive\-ready insights and recommendations.
* Exceptional relationship\-building and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and mobilize cross\-functional teams in a complex organization.
* Bilingualism (English and French) is a strong asset. If the successful candidate is in Québec, proficiency in both languages will be required to support clients from various provinces outside of Quebec
  

  

**When you join our team:**

  

  

* We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
* We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well\-being and inclusion are more than just words.
* As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.
